text:
Maya (growth): quick check-in before the weekly KPI: launch post + webinar drove a lot of registrants but our 'MQL' count isn't moving as expected. can someone confirm the definition we're using in the deck?
Jules (analytics): current dashboard MQL = lead with company_size + job_title + engaged_score>=3 within 7d of first touch. regs from the webinar are creating leads but many miss company_size attr.
Priya (events): registrations -> attendees is ~28% for this webinar (lower than our 35% benchmark). registration sources: paid social 49%, paid search 30%, newsletter 12%, organic 9%.
Tom (revops): are we double-counting webinar registrations as MQLs in any channel-level report? last month we had a spike when we temporarily marked regs with engaged_score 2 as MQLs.
Jules (analytics): no double-counting in pipeline queries, but attribution window matters: paid search often converts to MQLs after 10-12 days. our 7d window under-attributes paid search.
Nico (content): that matters for benchmark narrative. if paid search looks weak in the deck, SDRs will de-prioritize that channel in enablement. prefer we surface the attribution nuance.
dashbot: [metric] 'registrations_to_mql_rate' dropped from 12% -> 8% over the last week (alert threshold 20% relative change).
Maya (growth): proposal: for the next deck, show both 7d and 14d MQL numbers side-by-side and footnote the change. also include registration->attendee conversion tile.
Tom (revops): agree. also recommend we add a temporary column to the channel report showing 'time_to_mql' median so PMs can see delay patterns.
Jules (analytics): I can produce the 14d recompute and add a small timeseries tile. will take ~90m to run and validate. I'll also push a short saved query that computes median time_to_mql by channel.
Priya (events): i'll remind registrants about the webinar 1 hour before and add the calendar attachment to reduce drop-off. also will check if our confirmation email strips UTM params (that could hurt attribution).
Nico (content): i'll tweak the launch post copy for the next push to call out 'recording available' which might help late conversions and attribution capture.
Maya (growth): decision: keep webinar live as scheduled, update slides to show both windows + a note on registration->attendee conversion. hold any public benchmark statements about channel efficiency until we've shown 14d numbers.
Jules (analytics): posting first recompute here when done. will tag charts with a small badge '14d view' so we don't accidentally overwrite default dashboards.
Tom (revops): i'll add a one-week temp field to the enablement sheet with the 'time_to_mql' median per channel.
Priya (events): thanks team. quick ask: can we surface registrant email domains in the follow-up so SDRs can prioritize enterprise reps? Jules can you add a small top-domains list?
Jules (analytics): yes, will include top 10 domains in the recompute.
Maya (growth): action items roundup: Jules recompute + top-domains (90m), Tom add median time_to_mql to channel report (today), Nico update slides & post copy (3h), Priya reminder email tweaks (1h). we'll re-run KPI review in this channel before sending to leadership.
Nico (content): small note: recommend we label the deck version clearly (v2-attrib-note) when we upload to the shared drive.
Maya (growth): perfect. thanks all. we'll reconvene here after the recompute. :slightly_smiling_face:
